gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.title: Your life story
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.creator: On to your looks
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.skip.ask: Would you rather skip the story?
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.skip.desc: Your life is picked at random. You can still read it over and change any of it before you make your character.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.summary_sub: Read it over. Once lived, it's yours for life.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.lead: Point at an answer to hear how it goes, and what it gives you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.no_realms: No realm stands in this world yet.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.gives.free: +%s attribute points to spend as you like
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.gives.noble: Goodwill with the realm you name
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.gives.purse: A few extra silver to start
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hold.title: Your story is being written
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hold.realm: The kingdoms of this land are rising
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hold.harbour: A whaler is being fitted out for you
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hold.future: The future is still being made
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hold.arriving: The world takes shape around you
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hold.road: A road is being laid for you
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.1: Anyone can climb a wall. A climber's training only makes the grip last longer.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.2: Raise your guard as a blow lands to parry it. Time it close for a perfect parry.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.3: Watch for the glint. Heavy blows and gunshots flash just before they land.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.4: Hold use on a downed enemy to finish it. Every kind of weapon does it its own way.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.5: A villager's name is theirs to give. Ask for it, and you'll remember them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.6: Folk of other lands speak tongues of their own. Not everyone will understand you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.7: Blood stays where it falls for a while. Hunters, beasts and monsters follow it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.8: A loose rock makes a fine throw, and a grim finisher.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.9: Iron tools and weapons are forged at the anvil, not put together at a table.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.10: Hot metal wants tongs. Quench, polish and hone a blade to raise its grade.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.11: The rarest chests are locked. A lockpick and a steady hand will open them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.12: Town bounty boards carry notices. Pull one down to take the job.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.13: Merchants post orders for goods. Fill them for coin and good standing.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.14: Towns have work for those who want it. Wages are paid at dusk.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.15: A saw cuts wood and stone into thin layers, for finer building.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.16: The seasons turn. Crops, weather and the land change with them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.17: The fallen aren't always dead. Friends can bind their wounds and help them up.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.18: A broken arm spoils your aim. A broken leg makes flying a struggle.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.19: Every horse breed has its strengths. Mares and stallions are not alike.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.20: A horse you have raised will stand and defend you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.21: Coaches, cabs and rickshaws carry you along the roads for a fare.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.22: Ships can be boarded by their ladders. Their crews walk the decks.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.23: Alchemy begins with study. Research first, then infuse.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.24: Flux left lying around seeps into the land and corrupts it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.25: Amethyst attunes you to mana. Only the attuned can see its glow.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.26: Festering wounds can be cleansed by restoration magic, or a potion of cleansing.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.27: The forbidden arts are a crime in every realm.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.28: Your standing with a realm decides how its guards treat you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.29: Outlaws of the realms may find barbarian camps more welcoming.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.30: Everyone has a temper. Some help the fallen, some run, some pick fights.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.31: Guards clear monsters out of ruins near their towns before folk go near.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.32: A few villagers carry a gift. Some of them will teach it, if you ask.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.33: A power awakens on its own after a few days. The powers menu shows what each key does.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.34: Hold a warhammer high and let it fall for a crushing slam.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.35: A rapier lunges. Lock on to a foe and it reaches farther.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.36: Each heritage has its own body, its own strengths and its own looks.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.37: Some who come close to death come back with a spirit at their shoulder.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.38: Nights are truly dark. Carry a light.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.39: A cooking pot and a skillet make dishes no crafting table can.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.40: Blunt blows crush spiders. Explosions leave little behind.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.41: Gather friends into a party to share the road and the fight.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.42: Larger forms see the world from higher up, and reach farther.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.43: A clockwork golem is built through alchemy, not at a table.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.44: Tinkers' tables build weapons part by part. Every part changes the whole.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.45: Build a pigeon roost under open sky, and the criers' birds will bring you Tidings of great happenings.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.46: Tidings are rare and tell only of wars, fallen crowns and the like. Town boards carry all the rest of the news.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.47: Word meant for you alone, a spy's report or a lost parcel, comes by messenger, roost or not.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.48: Hit a great foe hard enough and its guard breaks. While it kneels, your next blow lands far harder.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.49: A sprinting or jumping blow breaks a boss's guard faster.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.50: Every fallen boss king teaches the world something. Anvils, smithing and enchanting wait on them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.51: Until the Goblin King falls, only the stone anvil will ring.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.52: Right-click a stair or slab to sit. The Sit key sits you anywhere; press it again to change how.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.53: Sit by a lit campfire to rest, warm up and heal.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.54: Draw a schematic onto a Building Plan at the Mason's Table, lay it down, then fill in the ghost blocks.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.55: Offer a Building Plan to a settlement, and its builders will raise it for you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.56: Armour gets dirty in mud, swamps and sand. Rain, water or a wet sponge washes it clean.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.57: Blood magic draws on the stains spilled on the ground around you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.58: Hang a carcass on a meat hook over a blood grate to bleed it. Unbled meat spoils sooner.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.59: Every settlement keeps a butcher and a healer. Ask a villager the way if you can't find them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.60: Until the Ogre King falls, no smith can work a smithing table or forge heavy arms.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.61: The enchanting table stays cold until the Skeleton Lord laughs his last.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.62: End portal frames won't take an eye until the Wither is dust.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.63: Harsher lands ask more of you. Some won't open until enough boss kings have fallen.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.64: Get up from a beating and you'll be weaker for half a day. A night's sleep ends it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.65: Fall in front of your enemies and they may finish you. Righteous guards arrest you instead.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.66: You can't punch down a tree. Knap a flint hand axe first.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.67: A felled tree falls to its heavier side. Stand clear of where it will land.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.68: New clothes come only from a tailor, for a few coins.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.69: Drink often and dress for the weather. Heat and cold both wear you down.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.70: Write a letter, seal it, and send it by pigeon or courier to anyone, by the name they go by.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.71: Sneak behind someone and hold use to pick their pocket. Stay with them, or they'll feel your hand.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.72: Not every chest is only a chest.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.73: Breaking what isn't yours in a town is a crime. Your own blocks are yours to break.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.74: Tap jump and sneak together twice to drop flat and crawl through gaps one block high.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.75: Set a carried head down facing a wall to hang it as a trophy.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.76: Blood caught in a grate makes blood sausage and blood meal.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.77: Whales roam the far oceans. A harpoon with a rope on it ties your boat to one.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.78: Festival bouts are held in the realms. Win the bracket, and your name will be said there.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.79: Train where your power is tested: wind on cold peaks, darkness in water by night.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.80: A weighted gi makes training count for more.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.81: Villagers help up only their own. A stranger may have to wait for a friend.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.84: Fit a lock to a door or chest, and only its key opens it. Anyone else has to pick it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.85: Towns lock their houses and shops at night. Being seen picking a lock in town is burglary.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.82: Cut gems on a lapidary wheel. Rush a stroke before it spins back up and the gem chips.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.83: A jeweller's bench sets a cut gem in a forged frame. The piece is only as good as the worse of the two.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.86: Hold an Expertly forged or better weapon or armour piece in your main hand and a cut gem in your off hand, then sneak-use a Smithing Anvil to set the gem. Tongs in the off hand pull it out whole.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.gives.echo: Something in you answers this road: it awakens a day sooner
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.gives.moon_ki: Only ki keeps you breathing out there: you wake as a %s
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.together: %1$s took this road; you'll wake beside them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.together.realm: %1$s took this road for %2$s; take it for the same realm and you'll wake beside them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.flaws: Flaws: up to %1$s, +%2$s free attribute points each (taken: +%3$s)
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.flaw.light_slee: A hostile within %s blocks wakes you from your bed.
You take %s%% more from every melee blow.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.flaw.poor_swimm: %s%% slower in water, and your breath runs out faster.
In light level %s or less with no light in hand: Slowness, a darkened screen and %s%% slower mining.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.switch.wary.fx: You start %s reputation lower with every realm.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.switch.hunted.f: A bounty on you from day one, and a hired blade sent for you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.switch.rags.fx: No road kit at all: no gear, food or coin. Your Journal page, and whatever your aim is about (a blade, a mule, a pup, hired hands), still come.
You give up your story's attribute points. Finishing your aim pays them back x%s.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.87: Set a patron's offering on a plain shrine to give it to them. Pray there three days running and you are sworn.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.88: Favour slips if you leave your patron a few days. Pray, bring fitting offerings and do their kind of deeds.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.89: Swear to a new patron and the old one marks you: a scar that never fades, and days of trials in which its omens follow you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.90: A town cleric can ease the trials of one who turns away, for a price. The scar stays.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.91: Once you reach the Wildlands, rare temples to the patrons rise in the far places. Their champions are fought in groups; only the strongest fight one alone.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.92: A champion's weapon head falls for you by your third kill at the latest. Put it together at the Tool Station; it serves its patron's sworn best.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.93: Realms send envoys to sign treaties: recognition, safe passage, trade charters and aid. Wear a crown and seek an audience with your steward to send your own.
